notes: BEA news release exactly as served (17 pages), cut to pages 1-7 with pypdf (see holdout/SELECTION.md): page 1 headline and chart, page 2 two charts and price paragraph, page 3 'Real GDP and Related Measures' summary table, 'GDP for 2024' and the next-release line, pages 4-5 'Technical Notes', page 6 the list of news release tables, page 7 Table 1. Pages 8-17 (Tables 2-8, Appendix Tables A-B) are not in the file. Headings: the release title (largest bold text on page 1; '(Advance Estimate)' is a second, smaller line and is not part of the listed string) and the bold stand-alone lines 'GDP for 2024', 'Technical Notes', 'Sources of change for real GDP', 'Impact of Hurricane Milton on fourth-quarter 2024 estimates' and 'News release tables'. The 'News Release' banner, the BEA logo header and the chart titles and labels are not checked (they may be images). Table titles are captions, not headings. Tables: the page-3 summary table is complete (5 rows x 2 columns, no header row). Table 1 is PARTIAL by design (hand transcription of all 43 lines x 22 columns was judged too error-prone): its three header rows plus lines 1-7, 16, 19 and 22, every cell as printed; table_precision is therefore expected to be below 1 for a complete conversion. Header layout: 'Line', the empty label column and the annual columns '2022', '2023', '2024' span all three header rows and are written in the top row; 'Seasonally adjusted at annual rates' spans the 16 quarterly columns and is written in the first column it covers, the year groups 2021-2024 likewise in the second row, then the quarter row; covered positions are empty strings (not scored). The line number is printed in the first and the last column. Line 22's label is printed on two lines ('Government consumption' / 'expenditures and gross investment') with its values on the second line and is written joined. Negative values are written with ASCII hyphen-minus: the printed sign is hyphen-width (narrower than a digit); the text layer was not read, so if it encodes U+2212 those cells fail for every converter alike. Cross-checks: Table 1 line 1 shows 2.3 for 2024 Q4, 3.1 for 2024 Q3, 2.8 for 2024 and 2.9 for 2023, as the text says. Each must_contain phrase occurs once in pages 1-7 (the Table 1 title occurs twice, on pages 6 and 7, so it is not used); no phrase crosses a page break or a hyphenated line end. ordered follows pages 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 6. Noise: the only repeated furniture is the logo header and the footer 'Page N of 17' on pages 2-6 (a different number on each page), so noise is empty; the text is ragged-right with no line-end hyphenation, so absent is empty. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 150-300 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, mastheads, cover art, chart labels) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants, the '>=' sign), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
